listing.name: Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit (NFS Recompiled)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Static recompilation with release zip and original-data instructions. Limits: Maintainer explicitly calls it a toy project; Linux runnable route exists with game-specific defects to qualify. Upstream platforms: Linux native C++ release/source route; original executable is Win32 x86 input, not proof of host CPU. Selected Linux package/build CPU unknown; other host platforms only potential. Original data: Supply an original Need for Speed III: Hot Pursuit installation plus its CD Fedata/GameData content. Source generation requires nfs3.exe, eacsnd.dll, softtria.dll and voodoo2a.dll in nfs3hp/. Exact supported language/patch and binary hashes are not stated in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
